name: ledger
description: Personal finance tracker for expenses, savings, debts, EMIs, credit card bills and subscriptions. Self-host it free on Netlify + Supabase, or use the GitHub Pages version that keeps your data encrypted in your own private GitHub repo.

paragraphs: A personal-finance web app for one person: day-to-day expenses, monthly income and savings, debts, loans/EMIs, credit card bills and subscriptions, plus a Dashboard that combines them.

This is the hosted edition. Each copy runs on its own Netlify site (the website and the API) and Supabase project (Postgres and sign-in), on their free tiers, with exactly one user: the owner. Every request needs the owner's sign-in. A copy can show every section or only some of them (ENABLEDMODULES), for example expenses only.
docs/DEPLOY.md. It assumes no prior Netlify or Supabase experience.
